<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,807)>But that was then! Things have changed!
<$voicel(1,5)>I’d come to believe this world was down to a population of
one—me.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>But today, out of nowhere, I met the two of you! <$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,664)>Hope
springs anew!

<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,656)>By the way, where in the world have you two been up
until now?

<$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)>Hmm... I don’t really remember too well...
<$voicel(2,5)>I always used to take naps next to a nice, clear pond.
<$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,1)>But this time...I woke up here, flat on the ground.
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,6)>Maybe I slept a little too much.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,13)>Is that so? Fascinating...
<$voicel(1,3)>But this whole area’s a total wasteland. I don’t know of any
ponds around here...

<$motion(1,654)><$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(2,803)>Forget about that—look at this!
<$voicel(2,7)>See? The ground around here’s turned green!
<$voicel(2,5)>I bet it grew because you sprayed water around here!
<$voicel(2,10)>That’s so awesome!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,801)>Oho... It’s true! The ground was parched, but now it’s
sprung back to life! <$voicel(1,10)>It’s only a bit, but it looks just like it
did in the good old days!

<$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)><$emotion(1,13)>... It seems you might have some
sort
of
mysterious power.
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,3)>What do you say? <$voicel(1,8)>Will you <$cdef(27)>water the ground and plants
around here for us?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>If you do, this place could become so much nicer to live
in—like it was before!
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(1,4)>Yeah! Great idea!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Will you <$cdef(27)>water the ground and plants</color> around here for us?

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)>Why don’t you try watering an area where there’s a lot of
dry tall grass in one place?

<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,23)>If the dry grass can be restored to fresh, green tall
grass, <$voicel(1,7)>it might help refresh my own memory about what
it was like when Pokémon lived here long ago.
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)>Hooray! This tall grass is all green again!

<$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,4)>There was lots of tall grass like this where I used to
live, too!
<$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,1)>Wow! Some flowers bloomed!

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,8)>I bet it’d be even nicer around here with a bunch of
beautiful flowers blooming all over the place.
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,1)>Wowww! That tree was dried up, but it looks all better now!
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,8)>I bet we can get berries from this tree too. I can’t wait!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)>Oho! So there are berries to pick now, eh?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,9)>You can pick and use berries however you like.
<$voicel(1,5)>If you don’t mind leaving a few on the trees, Pokémon
should be able to help themselves to some <$voicel(1,8)>when they’re
hungry.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,23)>Either way, the berries will grow back after a bit of time
has passed.
<$voicel(1,9)>I’ll leave the berry managing to you. <$comeff(1,10)>Hohoho!

<$voicel(1,7)><$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)>Ohhh, this brings back memories!
<$voicel(1,9)>Back in the day, there was tall grass like this all over the
place around here!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Seeing such fresh, green tall grass makes me feel like
Pokémon might return at any moment...
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,14)>Oho! Now a <$cdef(27)>Bulbasaur</color>’s come round!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)>You know, <$cdef(27)>, ever since I met
you,
<$voicel(1,8)>Pokémon
have
been
reappearing
one
after another.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>It seems you really do have some sort of mysterious power!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,9)><$facial(1,1)>I don’t suppose you could carry on making comfy habitats
for Pokémon, <$cdef(27)>?
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,9)>Doing that might make it possible to see a world
<$voicel(1,10)>overflowing with Pokémon again, just like the old days!
<$comeff(1,13)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)>Naturally, I’ll help out too. If there’s anything you’re ever
wondering or unsure about, don’t hesitate to ask me!

<$voicel(3,3)><$motionoff(3,804)><$comeff(3,7)><$facial(3,7)>The ground here is too dry, and the grass is all wilty, and...
And it’s nothing like where I lived before!

<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,807)>Can you help, <$cdef(27)>? Would you
water
the
dry
tall
grass? Pleeeaaase?
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,9)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,806)>I wanna make this place way greener!

<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,49)>If you do that for me, I’ll teach you something really neat
to say thanks!
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,14)>Please <$cdef(27)>water a little more dry tall grass</color>!

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,661)>Why don’t you give <$cdef(27)>Bulbasaur a hand with their request?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)>I’d wager we can make this place a lot greener if you <$cdef(27)>use
your <$sklfull(3)> on the dry tall grass!

<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,10)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,803)>Oh, you watered some dry tall grass! <$voicel(3,8)><$emotion(3,39)>The place looks
greener now! Thank you!

<$voicel(3,7)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,9)>Since you helped me out, I’ll teach you my move!
<$facial(3,1)>Watch this!
<$voicel(3,10)><$facial(3,1)>Ta-daaa!
<$voicel(3,9)>Whatcha think? That move’s called <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(1)></color>!

<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,14)>It’s actually s’posed to send leaves flying at your
opponent...
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,10)><$facial(3,4)>But it looks like when YOU use it, it makes tall grass grow
out of the ground!
<$voicel(3,9)><$emotion(3,1)>I think that’s a very “you” way of using the move!

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,801)>I recommend talking to the other Pokémon, not just me!
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,9)>I’m sure they’ll be happy to help you out.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)>Now that I think about it, there’s not much food to be
found around here.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,14)><$kfacial(1)><$motion(1,663)>The Pokémon who’ve returned may start feeling
rather peckish...

<$voicel(1,3)>Back in my day, there were plenty of <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>
growing on the trees here.
<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)>If you find any <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>, would you mind sharing
with the other Pokémon? <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)>I’m sure they’d be very pleased!

<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,32)>It’d be really fun if more and more Pokémon started
showing up around here!

<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,31)>But right now, I’m hungry... I wish I had a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>
or something...
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)>Oooh, this tall grass looks awesome!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,29)>Hey, I was wondering...
Think it’d be OK for me to live here in this tall grass?
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,801)>Great! Thank you, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,3)>Aww, c’mon! Pleeeaaase? I really, really like this place—it
reminds me of where I used to live!

<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,3)>C’mon, don’t be like that... There’s nowhere else around
here where I could live...
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,1)>Yayyy! Thank you, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>!

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)>Hey there, <$cdef(27)>! Great timing.
I’m lookin’ for some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1419)>. <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,806)>Any chance you’ve
got <$cdef(27)>2 of ’em on ya? <$voicel(4,6)><$emotion(4,49)>It’d really help me out!

<$voicel(4,1)><$motion(4,814)>I was asleep for so long, my move’s really lost its edge.
<$voicel(4,6)>Figured cutting a couple <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1419)> might help
me sharpen up, y’know?

<$voicel(4,9)>Tell ya what, bring me some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1419)>, and I’ll show
you my super sweet move. <$voicel(4,8)>Bet you could learn it yourself!
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,3)>Hey! You find the <$cdef(27)><fqty(2)><$ifull(1419)></color>? I need <$cdef(27)>2</color> of ’em.

<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,3)>Yeah, very nice! These look perfect for practicing on.
<$voicel(4,5)>All right, time to cut loose... Watch closely!
<$voicel(4,7)><$facial(4,4)>Aw yeah! It’s all coming back to me!
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,1)>That move’s called <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(5)></color>! Think you can learn it?

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Oh, hey, <$cdef(27)>. You got any
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(404)>
on you?

<$voicel(4,3)><$facial(4,9)><$comeff(4,7)>I want some to practice moves on, but I’m not finding any
that make the grade.

<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,14)><$facial(4,4)>It’d really help me out if you could bring me <$cdef(27)>2 decent-
sized <$cdef(27)><$ifull(404)>.
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,10)>It’d be great to get <$cdef(27)>2</color> <$cdef(27)><fqty(2)><$ifull(404)> </color>to use for my training.

<$voicel(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$comeff(4,5)>Hey, thanks for bringing those <$cdef(27)><$ifull(404)>!
<$voicel(4,6)><$facial(4,1)>All right, let’s get down to business...
<$voicel(4,6)><$motion(4,200)>Hup! <wait(0.1)>Hup! <wait(1.4)><$voicel(4,10)>Hyaaah!

<$voicel(4,9)><$facial(4,5)>Nice, that was great practice. The move I just used is
called <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>.

A Pokémon <$icon(2845)><$cdef(27)>request has been recorded in
your Pokédex!
Press the <$keyicon(4)> button to open the main menu, then select
<$icon(2845)><$cdef(27)>Requests to check it out!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)>It seems <$cdef(27)>Squirtle would like a home here.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Do you think you can use your moves to make another
<$cdef(27)><$hatname(3)> habitat?
